display.purpose: App title; steps down once inside a room.

title.purpose: The revealed target name and the host's big count.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono labels, margin titles, group headings, kicker.

motion.name: stamp-thunk
motion.purpose: The Confidential stamp lands once, on a game's first reveal; only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decisive action per sheet: Join, Start game, Leave (confirm).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font:700 16px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);background:var(--accent, #b4232f);color:var(--accent-ink, #ffffff);cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink-outlined companion action: Create a new room, Copy invite link, Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{font:700 16px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--ink, #141a24);background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #141a24);cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--bg, #eef1f4)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Leave Link
components.description: Underlined pencil-gray text button for Leave, still 48px tall, in its own leave zone.
components.css: .ds-btn-link{font:500 14px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);min-height:48px;padding:12px 0;border:none;background:none;color:var(--muted, #5b6576);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-link:hover{color:var(--ink, #141a24)}.ds-btn-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Labelled Field
components.description: Mono label over a recessed paper field with a 3:1 field edge and signal-red caret.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.ds-label{font:700 12px/1.5 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted, #5b6576)}.ds-input{font:400 17px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--field-line, #7f8999);border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg, #eef1f4);color:var(--ink, #141a24);caret-color:var(--accent, #b4232f)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #5b6576);opacity:1}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Case File Sheet
components.description: One per screen: blank sheet, 2px ink frame, opens with a state stamp.
components.html:
StandbyRoom code
KPWX

Share this code with the group.
components.css: .ds-sheet{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;max-width:360px;padding:24px;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);border:2px solid var(--ink, #141a24);border-radius:4px;color:var(--ink, #141a24)}.ds-stamp{align-self:flex-start;font:400 15px/1.2 var(--display, 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', Impact, sans-serif);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--accent, #b4232f);border:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);padding:4px 12px;transform:rotate(-4deg)}.ds-label{font:700 12px/1.5 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted, #5b6576)}.ds-code{font:700 40px/1.2 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--accent, #b4232f)}.ds-body{margin:0;font:400 16px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--muted, #5b6576)}

components.name: State Stamp
components.description: Rotated signal-red stamp naming a sheet's state; lands with a thunk on first reveal.
components.css: .ds-stamp2{display:inline-block;font:400 15px/1.2 var(--display, 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', Impact, sans-serif);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--accent, #b4232f);border:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);padding:4px 12px;transform:rotate(-4deg)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-stamp2:hover{animation:ds-thunk .35s ease-out}}@keyframes ds-thunk{from{transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1.6);opacity:0}to{transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1);opacity:1}}

components.name: Redacted Reveal
components.description: Dashed 'cut here' box with a fixed-width redaction bar; hold or tap to show the name, turns solid red while showing.
components.css: .ds-reveal{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;max-width:320px;min-height:96px;padding:24px 16px;border:1px dashed var(--muted, #5b6576);border-radius:4px;background:var(--bg, #eef1f4);color:var(--ink, #141a24);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}.ds-reveal:active{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--accent, #b4232f)}.ds-reveal:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-bar{display:inline-block;background:var(--ink, #141a24);color:transparent;border-radius:2px;font:400 36px/1.05 var(--display, 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', Impact, sans-serif)}.ds-hint{font:500 13px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--muted, #5b6576)}

components.name: Dossier Metadata
components.description: Mono margin labels beside plain values; the system's way of stating facts.
components.html: <dl class="ds-meta"><dt>Agent</dt><dd>Bo</dd><dt>Room</dt><dd>KPWX</dd><dt>Status</dt><dd>Waiting for the host to start the game.</dd></dl>
components.css: .ds-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:4px 16px;margin:0;font:400 14px/1.5 var(--body, Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif);color:var(--ink, #141a24);max-width:340px}.ds-meta dt{font:700 12px/1.5 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted, #5b6576);padding-top:2px}.ds-meta dd{margin:0}

components.name: Host Tag
components.description: The only tag: non-interactive mono 'Host' marker in the roster.
components.css: .ds-tag{font:400 11px/1.5 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--accent, #b4232f);color:var(--accent, #b4232f);white-space:nowrap}

narrative.overview:
Every screen is a page in the same dossier: a sheet of paper with an ink frame, a rubber stamp in the corner, typed labels down the margin, and a redaction bar over anything secret. The tone is playful but serious. The spy-file theatre is played straight, the stamps and voice carry a wink, and the controls themselves never joke. The theatre is there to make secrecy feel real to a friend group standing in one room, each holding a phone.

The system is built for one narrow column on a phone held in one hand. Density is low and deliberate: one sheet per screen, one primary action per sheet, generous separation before anything destructive. Expression comes from the system's own few devices (stamps, frames, mono labels, redaction), never from added decoration. It is flat at rest, uses a single red, and works in light and dark from the same tokens.
keyCharacteristics: One case-file sheet per screen, framed in 2px Night Ink with 4px corners.
A rotated Signal Red stamp names each screen's state: Recruiting, Standby, Confidential.
Typed-paperwork labels: uppercase JetBrains Mono at 12px, with 0.1em letter spacing.
Heavy uppercase Archivo Black for the title, headings and the revealed name.
Secrets are redacted by default and shown only on an explicit hold or tap.
A 4px spacing scale with a 48px minimum control height.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is the only accent. There is no second hue for success, info or decoration; status is carried by words and grouping ("Waiting · 2", "Received · 6").

rules.name: The Ink Frame Rule
rules.body: Dividers use Rule Line, input borders use Field Edge, and containers use Night Ink. Never swap them: a Rule Line border on a control fails contrast, and a Night Ink divider shouts.

rules.name: The Typed Label Rule
rules.body: Every label, margin title or field name is uppercase mono. Body copy is never set in mono, and mono is never a costume for "technical"; it marks what has been filed.

rules.name: The Capitals Are Loud Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black appears only in capitals and only for the title, headings, stamps, the revealed name and the host count. Never use it for running text.

rules.name: The 48 Rule
rules.body: Every interactive control is at least 48px tall, links included. A small visible mark gets its tap height from padding.

rules.name: The Leave Zone Rule
rules.body: Leave and other irreversible actions live at the bottom, behind a 48px gap and a Rule Line divider, and confirm inline. Cancel comes first and takes focus.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. A shadow appears only in response to state, never as decoration, never as a zero-offset glow, and never as a hard offset block.

dos: **Do** open every screen's sheet with a stamp that names its state, in Signal Red capitals rotated -4°.
**Do** set every label, margin title and group heading in uppercase JetBrains Mono at 12px with 0.1em letter spacing.
**Do** keep every control at least 48px tall, and put irreversible actions behind the 48px leave zone with an inline confirm that puts Cancel first.
**Do** show facts as dossier metadata (mono label beside a value) rather than as chips, tiles or badges.
**Do** scale display sizes, the stamp and sheet padding with `clamp()` so the column holds at 200% zoom without sideways scrolling.
**Do** keep the system flat at rest; if a state needs lift, use an offset, soft-blur shadow for that state only.
donts: **Don't** show a target name unprompted. Redaction is the default state; a name appears only on an explicit hold or tap and seals itself again.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue. Signal Red carries all emphasis, and status is said in words.
**Don't** use Archivo Black for running text, or mono for body copy.
**Don't** add decorative shadows, glows, gradients or rounded pill shapes.
**Don't** outline a control in Rule Line; controls use Field Edge or Night Ink.
